page.layout: One page of running text, set full width, with a running head above it. The running head has two parts on one line: "V.àGeneua." at the left and "ACT. MARTYRVM," at the centre. No margin notes, no headings and no page number. A catchword sits at the lower right below the last line. Right-edge fragments belong to the neighbouring page and are left out.
